parameters.query:
select c.id as campaign_id, c.status, c.appointment_time, c.clinic_timezone,
       config.timezone, config.quiet_hours_start, config.quiet_hours_end,
       config.automation_paused
  from public.broadcast_campaigns c
 cross join public.clinic_config config
 where c.id = $1::uuid;

select c.id as campaign_id, c.status, c.appointment_time, c.clinic_timezone,
       config.timezone, config.quiet_hours_start, config.quiet_hours_end,
       config.automation_paused
  from public.broadcast_campaigns c
 cross join public.clinic_config config
 where c.id = $1::uuid;
select automation_paused from public.clinic_config where id = true;

select c.id as campaign_id, c.status, c.appointment_time, c.clinic_timezone,
       config.timezone, config.quiet_hours_start, config.quiet_hours_end,
       config.automation_paused
  from public.broadcast_campaigns c
 cross join public.clinic_config config
 where c.id = $1::uuid;
